The [[High King]] of [[Hargeeva]], [[Makintay]], arranged for his son, [[Stevan Makintay|Stevan]], to [[Marriage/Legends|marry]] a high-born '''noblewoman''' in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]. Stevan had other plans, and intended to marry the lowborn commoner, [[Ketrian Altronel]], with whom he was in love with. His refusal to obey his father led to his disinheritance.
